title: Dont know how i feel about this
author: Affectionate_Fact854
selftext:
I'm going to leave the game and platform (anonymous)

So I recently got my MAIN GAME successfully bridged , implemented unplanned large sdk into the architecture,  the game was approved but when I went to look at the publish 

  
I noticed their platform replaced my capsule with ai generated version containing some of my assets but it's ai even if I provided my own capsule art 

  
I even clearly stated to them I don't have and aM not planning to add any ai generated assets and now they went and slandered the game with ai capsule art...

  
Why it bothers me is, the game has been on ichio for quite some time aswell ,it's listed on igmd and so forth , I did a lot of hours editing vector art, modifying paid assets, even making my own assets , with time lapse videos of the processes included.    
Like wtf is this even ... 

now I'm thinking of taking it down fromtheat platform

comments.author: Affectionate_Fact854
comments.body:
I have nothing against ai art 
But platforms shouldn't be allowed to go and slap their own art over a person's work without even requesting of such 

I'm not sure if it's automated procedure they do with listing's or what but not impressed with seeing this...

replies.author: CycleMother2006
replies.body: Your issue / concern seems like a reasonable one. It's not really about AI vs not, it's that unless you have some kind of agreement with a publisher (who then has a financial interest in your game's success) no one should be able to fuck around with your promotional materials, among other things. Though I'm going to assume this is not a reputable site like Steam or Itch doing it. Regardless I'd look into any terms  you signed off on to see if this is even within the bounds of what they are able to do.

replies.author: Affectionate_Fact854
replies.body:
Yup that's the thing , no it's not ichio or steam , it is considered a reputable web platform as large as crazygames that did this 

But I'm now looking into the terms and legal aspect since this was not even discussed 

They wanted the capsule art with the upload , I provided both capsule art sizes , took me a entire day to make ( something ) out of my assets.

So yea to replace my work , as a cross platform game with ai generated images could damage the games title in future and misrepresent my games visual work entirely ...
